parsed_json.up_exec: Find all distinct IC50 activity records (in nM) against the human single-protein target CHEMBL1980 (Sodium channel protein type 5 subunit alpha). For each record return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer PubMed ID, fallback to DOI), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Only include rows with a non-null canonical SMILES and a PubMed ID or DOI.
